admin_review.name: backupmemory
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Legacy raw local/shared database backups can include credentials and deleted/private content. Current selfbackup/persistence cover local diagnostics only, not equivalent shared export. Retention, encryption and deletion fencing are prerequisites.

admin_review.name: banchannel
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Legacy persistent bot-channel ban requires admission checks across normal replies, duo, jobs and voice. Current Scaramouche has no matching ban backend; a command-only port would falsely claim enforcement.

admin_review.name: unbanchannel
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Companion to the absent persistent channel-admission backend; do not restore a no-op unblock control.

admin_review.name: bannedchannels
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Inventory of the absent legacy channel-ban store; no safe equivalent state to report.

admin_review.name: rebanchannels
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Infers channel bans by scanning old messages; ambiguous text can recreate stale administrative state without confirmation.

admin_review.name: blockall
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Bulk blocks users selected from cached guild membership and sends unsolicited farewells; lacks exact scoped confirmation and current cross-path enforcement.

admin_review.name: reban
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Bulk global DM blocking based on inferred membership lacks exact scoped confirmation and the current missing admission backend.

admin_review.name: blockdm
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Legacy numeric/name targeting is ambiguous and mutates global DM access with unsolicited outbound messages; missing current admission backend and exact confirmation.

admin_review.name: unblockdm
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Legacy ambiguous global target selection and missing current DM block backend; cannot safely promise restored access.

admin_review.name: dmlist
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Enumerates private DM-only identities and relationship/message metadata for the owner. No current privacy-scoped export authorization or redaction contract.

admin_review.name: logs
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Exports another user's raw chat history to the owner. Can disclose secrets/private content; no current subject-scoped export, redaction or deletion guard.

admin_review.name: whois
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Aggregates global stored identities, message counts and shared-server membership; current privacy architecture does not authorize this cross-user profile export.

admin_review.name: owneronly
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Legacy in-memory global switch is not enforced by all current event/command/background paths. A partial port is unsafe and misleading.

admin_review.name: leaveserver
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Immediately leaves a guild selected by mutable index/name without durable exact-target confirmation. Membership mutation is not restored as an unrestricted owner action.

admin_review.name: rebuildmemory
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner/manage-guild history replay
admin_review.reason: Bulk replay of visible Discord history may resurrect forgotten content or another user's state. Needs tombstone-aware, scoped confirmed recovery.

admin_review.name: rebuildrank
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner/manage-guild history replay
admin_review.reason: Historical rank recovery replays other users' history without deletion fences or exact scoped confirmation; current relationship diagnostics are not recovery equivalents.

admin_review.name: rebuildstats
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner/manage-guild history replay
admin_review.reason: Historical statistics recovery replays other users' history without deletion fences or exact scoped confirmation; no safe current replay backend.

admin_review.name: rebuildrelationship
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner/manage-guild history replay
admin_review.reason: Recomputes relationships from historical content without deletion fences or exact scoped confirmation; may recreate deleted relationship state.

admin_review.name: fixdoc
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: INTENTIONALLY_DEFERRED_PHASE_2: Google Docs/Drive writes are outside this batch. Do not restore service-account writes or broaden Calendar/Tasks scopes.

admin_review.name: exportface
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Biometric template export is unsupported by the current per-user FaceProfiles API. Enrollment/recognition/deletion are present but are not export equivalents.

admin_review.name: importface
admin_review.authorization: Historical owner checks (some fail open if OWNER_ID unset)
admin_review.reason: Biometric template import can overwrite identity templates and bypass enrollment provenance/consent. No safe current import API or migration is authorized.
